newsitem.title: USA: ComEd taking Quad Cities 1 off line.
newsitem.headline: ComEd taking Quad Cities 1 off line.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co (ComEd) is taking the turbine at its Quad Cities 1 nuclear power plant off line to complete repairs to the unit, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Friday.
Power production at the 789 megawatt (MW) unit is currently 33 percent and dropping, the NRC said in its daily status report.
The unit, in Cordova, Ill., will not entirely halt power generation while it is off the grid, but cut it back to just 15 percent, the NRC said.
The report did not indicate how long ComEd plans to have the unit off line.
Quad Cities 1 was producing at 65 percent of its rated capacity Thursday while slowly ramping up after a week-long outage to repair its electronic relay system.
ComEd is a subsidiary of Unicom Corp.
